title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Use the title architect, or hold out as an architect or as practising architecture, only if registered.

sources.title: Architects Act 2004 (WA)
sources.quote: A natural person, other than a registered person, must not — (a) use a restricted word as part of the person’s title or description; or (b) hold himself or herself out as being an architect, a person who practises architecture or a person who is qualified to practise architecture;

reach.condition: if it represents itself or its staff as architects
